title: Class Expansion Pack - Paladin, Gunslinger & Alchemist
description:
Three new classes for co-op or solo: the Paladin, the Gunslinger and the Alchemist, shipped as one mod so a lobby only has to match a single gameplay-affecting dependency.

Early playtest build (v0.0.1) against game v0.107.1. Requires BaseLib 3.4.5 exactly; 3.4.6+ is not yet supported. Character bodies are recoloured base-game rigs for now; some card and relic art is placeholder; balance is in progress. Everyone in a co-op lobby must be on the same version.
changeNote: v0.0.1: first playtest build. Requires BaseLib 3.4.5.
